extracted.name: Waffles
extracted.description: These are easy to make and turn out perfect.
instruction_lines: In separate bowl using a hand mixer beat the eggs until they are light yellow and fluffy.
Add vanilla extract to egg mixture
Mix the egg mixture into the dry ingredients.
Add melted butter and milk to mixture, blend until smooth.
Heat waffle maker. Spray with cooking spray.
Add to waffle maker and cook until golden brown. My waffle maker takes 3/4 cup per waffle. I get 5 large waffles from this recipe.
